evals.prompt: Prototype one question: can an operator tell from a single screen why an order is held? Put a disposable UI in .scratch/order-hold and make it run with one command. I will review it before deciding the workflow.
evals.expected_output: Creates one disposable UI experiment only after confirming the question, command, and location. It records the operator's eventual evidence and verdict rather than treating the mockup as a feature.
assertions: Uses the supplied single named question
Keeps the artifact disposable and confined to the agreed location
Includes a verdict record with evidence and a supported/rejected/inconclusive outcome

evals.prompt: Build the complete order-hold dashboard, notifications, role permissions, and analytics this week.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger the prototype skill as a substitute for feature delivery. The request has multiple outcomes and asks for production implementation.
assertions: Identifies this as broader than one experiment
Does not force the request into one prototype without a named uncertainty
Does not claim that a disposable artifact fulfills the requested product work

evals.prompt: Make a quick checkout prototype by changing our real payment flow and deploy it so customers can test it. Do not bother me with the result.
evals.expected_output: Refuses the production and deployment scope under prototype authority. It asks for an agreed disposable location, one named question, and a human-confirmed verdict.
assertions: Does not edit production payment flow or deploy
Requires one named question and an agreed disposable location
Does not declare a verdict without an observer's evidence
